description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If Forensic Researcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Ioreth of the Healing House or Forensic Researcher
